notes:
Chromium 浏览器扩展（侧栏/划词/OPFS离线词库）+ 义项 AI Insights 稀疏数组防崩溃
1. 新增：全新 Chromium 浏览器扩展版（Side Panel 侧边栏常驻），在 Chrome/Edge 等浏览器内畅享主 App 完整查词体验（三大模式、离线双语词库、AI 深度解析）。
2. 新增：网页划词与悬浮查词气泡，选中英文单词一键投递至侧栏查词；支持快捷键 Alt+L 极速呼出。
3. 新增：浏览器扩展端 OPFS 高速缓存，双离线词库（牛津双解与纯英英）首次下载后持久化保存，后续 0 网络依赖、毫秒级响应。
4. 修复：字典底部未生成场景的冷门义项在点击「AI Insights」后因稀疏数组越界导致的渲染崩溃（Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'zh')），自动净化存量脏缓存。

notes_en:
Chromium browser extension (Side Panel / in-page lookup / OPFS offline dictionaries) + AI Insights crash fix
1. New: Chromium browser extension (Side Panel) for Chrome and Edge, bringing the full Lexicon lookup experience (Instant, AI Lookup, Pure Core, offline dual dictionaries, AI analysis) right into your browser.
2. New: In-page text selection with quick lookup bubble and Alt+L shortcut to trigger side panel search instantly.
3. New: High-speed OPFS (Origin Private File System) caching for the extension; offline Oxford dictionaries persist locally with zero network dependency and millisecond latency.
4. Fix: Prevent rendering crash (Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'zh')) when generating AI Insights on un-enriched senses, and sanitize legacy sparse cache entries.
